shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' .lore/dod.md; printf '\\n--- status ---\\n'; git status --short --branch; printf '\\n--- files ---\\n'; rg --files src specs .lore | sort | sed -n '1,240p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "command -v lore-query-trace || true; sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; printf '\\n--- acceptance ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts; printf '\\n--- hooks ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.hooks.test.ts; printf '\\n--- spec ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; printf '\\n--- changelog ---\\n'; sed -n '1,160p' CHANGELOG.md; printf '\\n--- commands ---\\n'; sed -n '1,200p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"doc\\(|specs/hal-engine-config-hooks|spec:\" src/config.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs scripts | head -80; sed -n '1,55p' src/config.test.ts; sed -n '1,120p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'test -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs && echo yes || echo no; npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.hooks.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; git diff --check; git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.hooks.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.hooks.test.ts && git commit -m "fix beforeSession test fixtures and coverage status" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
